thread:
elaine (docs): Heads up — the /v1/rerank API example in the API reference shows "queries" as a single string in the curl snippet. That’s inaccurate since we removed auto-wrapping of single-string queries. Creating a tiny docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3124

matt (eng): Good catch. Runtime expects queries to be an array of objects: [{ query: string, top_k?: number }]. We stopped accepting single-string queries last quarter, so examples must show array form only.

nina (sdk): I’ll update the JS/TS SDK snippets once docs are fixed. Note: current types are unioned (string | string[]) due to legacy. Planning a minor SDK PR to tighten to the object-array shape and add a short migration note.

jordan (api): Confirmed from API logs: single-string auto-wrap removed around 2025-11. Docs must state migration steps and the response ordering semantics (result entries align to queries via query_index).

elaine (docs): Can someone paste a corrected curl + JSON body and a compact example response so I can patch the PR? Prefer minimal but clear examples showing multiple queries and per-query top_k. Also would like a docs callout about per-doc metadata option.

matt (eng): Copy this example — it shows array of query objects and both string docs and object docs variants. Use whichever fits the page layout:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "rerank-large-v1",
    "queries": [
      {"query": "Where is tokenization documented?", "top_k": 5},
      {"query": "How to set up Dedicated capacity?", "top_k": 3}
    ],
    "documents": [
      "Doc A text...",
      "Doc B text...",
      "Doc C text..."
    ]
  }'

matt (eng): Minimal example response shape (abridged):

{
  "results": [
    { "query_index": 0, "scores": [0.97, 0.65], "document_indices": [0,2] },
    { "query_index": 1, "scores": [0.88, 0.40], "document_indices": [2,0] }
  ]
}

nina (sdk): Thanks — I'll update the SDK snippets to use queries: [{ query, top_k }] and push SDK PR referencing docs PR 3124. Will include a migration note: "If you previously supplied a single string for queries, update to an array of query objects."

jordan (api): Add a short migration callout in the API ref: "Deprecated: single-string queries were auto-wrapped previously; now you must send an array of query objects. The results array is ordered to correspond to the queries via query_index." Also mention you can supply documents as strings or objects (e.g., { id: "d1", text: "..." }) for per-doc metadata.

elaine (docs): Will add both examples (array-of-strings and array-of-objects for documents) and the migration callout. Will also add the note that results align by query_index. Pushing a small patch to PR 3124 now.

ci-bot: docs build for PR 3124 passed — https://ci.redwood.ai/3124/builds/89 ✅

nina (sdk): SDK PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/789 — updates types and snippets, references docs PR.

matt (eng): LGTM on content. Tiny suggestion: emphasize per-query top_k in the rerank param table so readers notice it easily.

elaine (docs): Done — added an inline callout and updated the rerank params table. Will merge once final proofread complete. Closing loop. 🚀
